text: This report recommends a change to the benefits program for exempt staff as we continue to make adjustments based on overall needs.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Adopted the recommendations contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 30, 2023) from the Director, Human Resources, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 30, 2023) from the Director, Human Resources, Toronto Zoo remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information about labour relations and/or employee negotiations.
